notes: Posted 14 May 2001, before Tatooine; the list has no Tatooine-set card, so the format is Premiere - Reflections II.

Title and description say the deck went undefeated at Minnesota States ('This is the exact deck I played at MN states'). Taken as a tournament deck at the 2001 Minnesota State Championship with finish 'Undefeated' as posted (no wiki page yet; no place given).

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order, Something Special Planned For Them; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order (the machine draft had dropped it); 'Something Special...' Something Special Planned For Them; 'MobPoints' Mobilization Points; 'DS2DB' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'CCDB' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (the Dark Cloud City docking bay); 'EndorDB' the Dark Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay).

Posted 'DV,DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith (the strategy calls him 'Choke Lord'); 'Mara Jade, TEH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; '4-LOM w/gun', 'IG-88 w/gun' and 'Boba Fett w/gun' the Enhanced characters 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, IG-88 With Riot Gun and Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Lt. Arnet' Lieutenant Arnet; 'Vader's Saber' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Mara's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
player_note: Justin Alfs says this is the exact deck he played at the Minnesota state championship, where it went undefeated; he says he would now put Carida back in and swap his second Emperor Palpatine for the Admiral's Order.
